title: The best way to eat and explore Granada like a local
text:
This tapas tour through the Old Town and Albaicin was such a great introduction to Granada. Carlos clearly knew the area inside out, leading us through narrow winding streets and hidden squares we never would have found on our own.

We stopped at several local spots, each with their own specialty, and it was a nice mix of classic Andalusian tapas alongside a few more unexpected bites. Getting a drink included with each tapa was a nice touch too, and portion sizes meant we left properly full rather than needing dinner after.
author: slicerjack631

title: Wine and tapas in Granada
text:
Katia was an interesting and knowledgeable host. She introduced us to different wines of Spain which we had with food at 3 venues. She also introduced us to different olive oils so the evening was informative but also fun as we got to know the rest of the group.
We had a great evening enjoying the company and expertise of Katia.
author: ronam715

title: Grenada Tapas Tour
text:
Our Grenada Tapas Tour was the highlight of our trip. Did a tapas tour with the company ‘Not Just a Tourist’.
Miguel Girona was our guide. He was fabulous! We had so much fun and the places he took us to amazing.  Miguel also shared a lot of history and was knowledgeable about each if the places we visited. 
I highly recommend this tour with this company. Wonderful

title: Book Now Great Company& wonderful Guides
text:
Book now! We have done  many food tours when traveling and these people are extra special. Not only was the owner, Mahsa very accommodating and nice when we missed our connecting flight and missed part of the tour, but  She was very sympathetic and made  it her business to get us a tour the next day!
But that just had set the tone for the actual tour the next day with Rachel & Simo. They were charming , friendly and very personable. They are very knowledgeable about Granada but were  also worldly in  discussing other  cultures and traditions relative to the area to give a more worldly perspect
author: Kerline_C
